techStack.text: Use Three.js R180, WEBGPU, no fallback, rapier 0.19.3 for physics, Web Audio, Gamepad API; The rest of the tech stack is yours to choose.

artDirection.text: Use a stylized cel-shaded look for the game.

animation.text: Animation technique and implementation is your choice

testing.text: Write no tests, do no tests, testing will be done separately.

goal.text: the bundled single .html file exists in this folder's root, every feature in TASK.md is implemented with no TODOs, placeholders or stubs, and your final reply contains the Source Information, Engine Feedback and Prompt Feedback sections.
